frame.notes: The reference has no outer frame around the page — the page background #0f1726 is the canvas; only the cards carry borders.

cards.notes: Cards are plain 1px solid rectangles with muted blue-gray borders #334155 and rounded corners ~10px. Low-contrast subtle containment lines on dark surfaces; no glow, no brackets.

dividers.notes: Thin 1px horizontal separators between list rows (announcements) and under card headers (calendar header divider, astronaut header divider, footer top divider). Sidebar-to-content vertical divider ~#2e3a4d.

inputs.notes: Search input is a dark inset rounded rectangle (radius ~8px), border muted blue-gray.

activeIndicators.notes: Active nav item (Home) is a blue-filled rounded row (#3b82f6 fill, white text, ~6px radius) with a small white status dot — a filled active state rather than a left accent bar.

keyElements.description: Left navigation rail (~255px) with NAVIGATION heading, 5 nav links (Home active blue-filled, Missions, Astronauts, Resources, Settings), and a Need help? support card at the bottom
Top utility bar (~64px): search input (Search NovaFleet...), theme icon, notification bell with blue unread dot, circular JD avatar
Full-width Mission Dashboard hero card with blue-indigo gradient banner (#213f95 to #312d82), rocket icon, ORION EXPLORER IV title, green PRE-LAUNCH status pill
MISSION COUNTDOWN clock (05:14:23:05) inside the dashboard card
4 compact metric tiles inside the dashboard card: Crew 6, Duration 142d, Altitude 408km, Systems 100% (green)
Bordered footer: NovaFleet branding + copyright left, support/docs/bug/GitHub links right, version note v1.0.3

reference.name: MISSION DASHBOARD
reference.description: Wide mission summary card with countdown clock, 4 stat tiles (Crew/Duration/Altitude/Systems), and PRE-LAUNCH status pill

reference.name: FLEET CALENDAR
reference.description: Events This Week calendar card: 3 weekly events (Monday Mission Briefing 09:00, Wednesday Crew Training 14:30, Friday System Review 11:00) with leading icons, day labels, and View Full Calendar button

reference.name: ASTRONAUT OF THE WEEK
reference.description: Astronaut profile card: circular photo with blue ring, Dr. Abel Chen, Mission Specialist role (blue), italic quote, bio, View Profile blue button

reference.name: GALACTIC ANNOUNCEMENTS
reference.description: Announcement list card: 4 rows with colored status dots (red Orion launch, yellow Radiation Shielding, yellow Fleet-wide Update, green Research Achievements), title + summary + timestamp, View All link

reference.name: MISSION RESOURCES
reference.description: Resource list card: 4 rows (Mission Manual PDF, Training Materials DOCS, Star Charts APP, Equipment Specs PDF) with document icons, badges, last-updated timestamps, View All Resources button

matches.note: Clock/specs slot becomes the mission countdown + stat readout
Gauge slot becomes the 4 compact metric tiles
Top-processes list becomes the announcement list with colored status dots
Traffic chart slot becomes the resource list with file badges

featured.name: FLEET CALENDAR
featured.note: Calendar widget replaces the WORLD VIEW globe — a self-contained weekly-events card with day labels, event rows, and a View Full Calendar button
